meta.name: computer-use
meta.description: OS/window-level inspection and input in visible local app windows through `orca computer`: native apps, external browser windows (Chrome, Edge, Safari), and app webviews. Not for Orca's embedded browser (use `orca-cli`) or page-only automation (use Playwright or CDP).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作本地可见应用窗口,完成点击、输入与界面内容读取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让程序代替你在桌面应用窗口里手动点击和输入。
copy.tagline_en: Automate clicks, typing, and reading content inside visible local app windows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a program to click and type in desktop app windows for you.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 可以通过 `orca computer` 检查并操作本机可见的应用窗口,包括原生应用、外部浏览器窗口和应用内嵌网页;动手前会先加载与本次 Orca 版本匹配的指南。
howto.when: 当你要在本机可见的应用窗口里做检查或输入时触发;不适用于 Orca 内嵌浏览器或纯页面自动化等场景。

say.text: 帮我看看当前 Chrome 窗口里显示了什么
say.note: Claude 会先加载版本匹配的指南再操作

say.text: 在记事本窗口里输入这段文字
say.note: 对可见窗口发送键盘输入

say.text: 点击当前微信窗口里的发送按钮
say.note: 对可见窗口发送鼠标输入

howto.what_en: Claude inspects and sends input to visible local app windows via `orca computer` — native apps, external browser windows, and app webviews. It first loads the version-matched guide from your Orca executable.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to inspect or input into visible local app windows. Not for Orca's embedded browser or page-only automation.

say_en.text: Show me what's currently displayed in my Chrome window
say_en.note: Claude loads the version-matched guide first

say_en.text: Type this text into the Notepad window
say_en.note: Sends keyboard input to a visible window

say_en.text: Click the send button in the current WeChat window
say_en.note: Sends mouse input to a visible window
